**Finding submitted — deviation (INSURANCE).**

- **Only responsive clause:** § 14.6 (p0603). Searches for "insurance", and for coverage/E&O/cyber terms, returned no other provision anywhere in the Agreement.
- **Why it fails fallback:** 14.6 is mutual and does require insurance (including product liability), plus evidence on request and cancellation notice from RevMed — but it is qualified only by "consistent with normal business practices of companies similarly situated," with no monetary floors and no E&O or cyber/privacy coverage at all. The fallback requires quantified E&O ≥ USD 1M and cyber/privacy ≥ USD 2M, so the clause fails on a material term.
- **Target level:** fallback, at the fallback thresholds only — I did not volunteer the preferred CGL/2M E&O/5M cyber/workers' comp package.
- **Redline:** a new 14.7 imposing the two missing coverages on RevMed. I used insert_after rather than rewriting 14.6, so the existing self-insurance right for Sanofi, the evidence-on-request obligation, the pre-cancellation notice from RevMed, and the no-limit-on-indemnity savings sentence all survive verbatim. Nothing in the edit weakens our position or adds ancillary boilerplate.
